rationale.consistency: Uses the `existing` parameter idiom already used by parseOptCertIssuer, slices helpers, and comment style matching the package; small package-private helper fits the layout.
rationale.edge_cases: Invalid order errors before any state is touched; multiple `order` lines accumulate via existing; plugin order still the base via clone of directiveOrder; RegisterDirectiveOrder no longer aliases the default array.
rationale.scope: Changes are focused; the RegisterDirectiveOrder clone is justified by the 'default never mutated' requirement. Cloning the whole options map in Setup is broader than strictly needed and the follow-up delete(options, "order") is redundant after the clone.
rationale.readability: Clear helper name and good explanatory comments; replacing the bool with a nil-means-unsorted slice is a slightly magic sentinel, and the delete comment describes a case the clone already prevents.
rationale.robustness: No shared mutable state after init: directiveOrder is read-only, each adaptation owns its cloned slice, options map is copied so shared/reused maps are safe; slices.Index guarded against -1.
rationale.maintainability: Single source of truth via directiveOrderFor(options); order plumbed explicitly through buildSubroute/sortRoutes, so future callers must pass it. Nil-vs-empty slice distinction is a minor footgun to document.
